title: Ledger entry (written only by Table Core)

seat.description: Seat id, 'core' for Table Core, or 'owner:<id>' for owner approvals.

round.description: Extension (convene): how many decisions were already on the ledger when this entry landed. 0 means the table is still in its first round. Added by Table Core; clients never set it.

event.description: For kind=system: table_opened | seat_joined | floor_granted | task_opened | task_state | table_closed | time | audit

ts.description: Wall clock, audit only. Never included in projections.
